map.还有法向加速度？: Is There Also a Normal Acceleration?
map.有。法向(向心) a_n=ω²r 改方向、切向 a_t=αr 改大小，总加速度为: Yes. The normal (centripetal) component a_n = ω²r changes direction while the tangential a_t = αr changes magnitude; the total acceleration is the vector sum of the two.
map.切向加速度和向心加速度是一回事吗？: Are Tangential and Centripetal Acceleration the Same Thing?
map.不是。切向加速度反映转速变化的快慢（a_t=αr，变速转动时才不为 0）；向心加: No. Tangential acceleration reflects how fast the rotation speed changes (a_t = αr, nonzero only when the rotation is speeding up or slowing down); centripetal acceleration reflects how fast the direction changes (a_n = ω²r, present whenever there is rotation). In uniform rotation the former is 0 while the latter is not.
